# tcpshield_bedrock_tunnels (Data Source)

Lists the Bedrock tunnels of a network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tcpshield_bedrock_tunnels" "all" {
  network_id = data.tcpshield_network.main.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (Number) Network to list.

### Read-Only

- `tunnels` (Attributes List) The tunnels. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tunnels))

<a id="nestedatt--tunnels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tunnels`

Read-Only:

- `allocated_cname` (String) Hostname players connect to.
- `backend_set_id` (Number) Backend set the tunnel forwards to.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric tunnel id.
- `location` (String) Ingress location.
- `name` (String) Tunnel name.
- `network_id` (Number) Network the tunnel belongs to.
- `proxy_protocol` (Number) PROXY protocol mode, as the panel's numeric code.
